annotations.title: What a product is best for

description: What a product is best for, from its Guide's Best For: up to three uses, each with a one-line reason and how it is known (the maker's own page, the specification, a reported detail, or iDevice's own judgement). Or pass use_case (for example 'sleep', 'running', 'gaming', 'travel', 'photos and video') with an optional category to list the products on sale whose Guide puts that use in its top three.

category.description: Narrows a use_case search: glasses, rings, watches, earbuds, phones, headsets, fitness trackers or pendants

product_slug.description: A product_slug, e.g. 'oura-ring-4'. Gives that product's own uses.

use_case.description: A use, e.g. 'sleep', 'running', 'gaming'. With no product_slug, lists the products best for it.

name: get_best_for
title: What a product is best for
